documents.title: Official Finland–USSR frontier protocol identifying the 1920 Tartu boundary and demarcation records
documents.institution: Finland Ministry of Justice / Legal Register Centre (Finlex)
documents.notes: The official protocol states that the Finland–USSR state-boundary line was established by the 14 October 1920 Finland–RSFSR peace treaty (among later instruments) and that its course on the ground is defined by signed boundary-description protocols, boundary maps, boundary-mark protocols and other demarcation documents, including the 28 April 1938 package. This locates the authoritative documentary/cartographic lineage for the Tartu boundary without promoting any production geometry.
